```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "en_US.UTF-8"))  # else cat() writes non-ASCII as <U+2010> under the C locale
library(here)
# Inline SVG (not <img>) so its labels can be links; blank lines would end pandoc's raw HTML block.
# Drawn by reports/pipeline_diagrams.py; the second diagram is on reports/analysis.Rmd.
inline_svg <- function(file) {
  f <- here(file)
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(cat(sprintf("<p><i>Diagram file %s not found.</i></p>", file)))
  svg <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  cat(svg[nzchar(trimws(svg))], sep = "\n")
}
```

<style>
  .pipeline-svg svg { width: 100%; height: auto; }
  .pipeline-svg a:not(.key) text { fill: #1a5fb4; text-decoration: underline; }
  .pipeline-svg a:not(.key):hover text { fill: #0b3d7a; }
</style>

<div class="pipeline-svg">
```{r analysis, results = "asis"}
inline_svg("nsf_engines_pipeline_analysis.svg")
```
